name: aocl-compliance-suite
description: Enterprise-grade audit trails and compliance exports for AI agent decisions. Export SOC2, HIPAA, GDPR, and ISO 27001 reports. Debug with Trace Replay. Compare behaviors across versions. Track every handoff in multi-agent workflows.
shortDescription: Compliance exports, trace replay, comparison, and multi-agent correlation.
author: QUOX
marketingPoints: Never fail an AI compliance audit again
SOC2, HIPAA, GDPR, ISO 27001 - one click export
Debug production issues with Trace Replay

complianceExport.name: Compliance Export
complianceExport.description: Export complete audit trails in SOC2, HIPAA, GDPR, and ISO 27001 formats. Auditor-ready documentation with evidence bundles.

traceReplay.name: Trace Replay
traceReplay.description: Re-execute any historical trace with modifications. Debug production issues, test policy changes, and run what-if scenarios.

traceComparison.name: Trace Comparison
traceComparison.description: Side-by-side comparison of two or more traces. See timing deltas, decision differences, and content changes highlighted.

multiAgentCorrelation.name: Multi-Agent Correlation
multiAgentCorrelation.description: Track every handoff across multi-agent workflows. Swimlane visualization shows the complete journey across all agents.

scheduledReports.name: Scheduled Compliance Jobs
scheduledReports.description: Automatically generate compliance reports on a schedule. Weekly, monthly, or custom intervals.

evidenceBundles.name: Evidence Bundles
evidenceBundles.description: Download complete evidence packages for auditors. Includes trace samples, policy decisions, and verification results.

auditReports.name: Audit Report Generation
auditReports.description: Generate auditor-ready reports with executive summaries, detailed findings, and remediation recommendations.

complianceDashboard.name: Compliance Dashboard
complianceDashboard.description: Real-time compliance posture visibility. Track coverage, gaps, and trends across all compliance frameworks.
